Short Information : has released the notification for the post of ECCE Educator in the Department of Basic Education Uttar Pradesh (Moradabad). This recruitment has been issued for 90 posts. The online application process for UP Moradabad ECCE Educator Recruitment 2026 has started on 01 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 09 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UP Moradabad ECCE Educator Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

UP Moradabad ECCE Educator Recruitment 2026 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates must have passed a Bachelor’s Degree in Home Science as the main subject with a minimum of 50% marks from a university established by law and recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC). Candidates belonging to reserved categories will be eligible for a 5% relaxation in minimum qualifying marks as per government rules. OR
  • Candidates must possess a Diploma of at least two years duration in Teacher Nursery Training (NTT), CTT (Nursery), DPSE, or an equivalent qualification recognized by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE).
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.
